| | Friend,
Democrats seem to have a love for war and the boundless spending that comes with it. If dollars can be made, we will be in conflict. One of our own civilian contractors was killed, and [six other Americans were injured](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2b35d6ab27364bf499693db31a32ed42&_e=tqUBFbp2a8SnXkeG0PawUeu6edFAFYx0kLziJYfca1nauJyjWCfzDWj0zguAHaHTZStG4-JJ-G8H9OGLI1Ub9DsrHHsi34N4YPf80Uvc_GpadmsmRmReV32n2oyZ75Xy3dyW1ctjTHr8k60iiocz-R-xpBSIffLIvcFnKpaDMW8HC1HjXsiYmJPLrFWrLqy2cQPMA2hEx4snsvyFk_oNzZv0jOBEs3WN417yPvMtqkNXtyJ1EwREbqyS9-xH5zD7Ku-taBdW9V0f0gAzioXScQ%3D%3D) last week in Syria. The culprit was allegedly a drone of “Iranian origin.” I agree that we must hit back twice as hard when this happens—but will the foolishness ever stop? It’s a shame that we’re even in Syria to begin with! Washington learned NOTHING from the war in Iraq. We spent [$2 trillion](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2b35d6ab27364bf499693db31a32ed42&_e=tqUBFbp2a8SnXkeG0PawUSD0VM6jBf2mJHel_x9jBVeiqlRdbkQGKoWwbFKsMfPiKEOwulcMcNvHj0Jig4eABro1ZkfG9oEf7mO3IdkKywZTDLo1gV4NDlJGdd9vGqo4Tqs6Exo5VEKGtnFGprZ1MrZu97YTL1WD5e4AMKUR04v_JhZh2D7xaDacfz7uOFAZa4MBRkwgIlsrUKEBDYTt_em6PwGTZxVR9dEWnvZajCYhAwRbbCijLgFLvtNKfIchSQjYc67_LkgeDiM5aYrtINjn2gfLYidjKXKPVLVHknj17Kk1UAvsll-vrGUjTUv2) and lost more than [4,400 brave men and women](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2b35d6ab27364bf499693db31a32ed42&_e=tqUBFbp2a8SnXkeG0PawUVEKlMdNpNSRfTjm5kBgovssUR1xU9FLJSvaL2njQUGtbMT_SCO04sw7RrdFSyRSmH4LGP5W3jgKnsyyjcgPrRPspBGE6VV1eFmufeiRPqlNw7vixGCuDppna-lXMsOTVJAU9f7Lb9SSXo4ScD9NpX_RX00LKJR83qilBoct9qItIFeJg6E8DyUyP2M8pxDAsevN9kdqNMamqd52ZMPZF28E18CROSsMv-3CIMWfgTODvw9SFWU1OsTxpMozU0M72Q%3D%3D). To add fuel to the fire, consider the fact that we continue to [meddle in the war happening in Ukraine](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2b35d6ab27364bf499693db31a32ed42&_e=tqUBFbp2a8SnXkeG0PawUblAaFbncn4jvUfVsb6dfQ5AtMnStzMhC1cQKvXtHu2v5LwRN43IykSm9ZASli-W8c_JsSMrlzIbOqECalrR1fCJ3gCeQu9crmEuNUHbittGD5qluUDTMjZ2eDKGv7BZWtZD7LAHoehnBZEnDWbefOSY_L6YEuMEAA4a7oYTbkXr46bO6VWg2Svyb3K7qv_O7RDANkTI-5Ywfo6NVdk7-7hfTxlFaNEVGgMPlEA5G45BL_k9wS3k8jxBA2o9EGgt8g%3D%3D). Even if we don’t have a physical presence, we are funding war hawks who have a bottomless appetite for financial support. We must stop feeding the beast. We need to bring our men and women home. They take an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States. They don’t owe anything to these other countries. This is exactly why I am always in favor of [supporting legislation](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2b35d6ab27364bf499693db31a32ed42&_e=tqUBFbp2a8SnXkeG0PawUaeCnvSVUk5UaFw9GcWjD0Q94F1m7hzPfZnfLgBl1CRXI1SNu_jrvfOdPt_rl9E4HnH1NIAPmDzAMMTxIRmHZw4rlg5g6aKFh2HEFE18CWh4qvH4otEMiFKGJGdhg_4_PMC3i1XLbm-rkhJA6W52fqpR5-VHRk41E4R2HLZD-LOv-t2Jd5emT8AUOdXDi0PuXlPKp0vCeBIXWsDFOWIV4r1LRdJCOdMs4wiAf4da1FZpKNexpz8P1PS3wrMLfc4s7g%3D%3D) that would pull us out of these conflicts. [**Will you stand with me in this fight against Democrats feeding the greedy industrial war complex?**](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2b35d6ab27364bf499693db31a32ed42&_e=tqUBFbp2a8SnXkeG0PawURLSSMPhA18hlNg9h570OvE_qdBRi0ZSQ7i9lvHOhLrjswe9lO9Ur47CgYZPDMo-4n0H4I0tQZSiOlBv3XIDIiH_BBPxOTeMVgkfyz-ECUNSM7djdM7vWWfDgyr08r2jXD5UvadcEXaMG8SN4ytDnqXk-tf1WVNS-eL8u864J8NGfcKmsDHj73jvp6f2YRkShiyYkSpepukXOcsku1HtngV1Y0_axyRbRhO5u79rQsiinp9620rYLonihiSP5-8Q2WpBsOkdnWQ8-6bwD_idgVn-TpWBWHaMJFaeo-m-MFtuG8V04_m-54K4Zz0uoullrw%3D%3D) Thank you for your continued support, Tim Burchett

subject: 3️⃣ reasons to care about the Wisconsin supreme court race

We’ll keep this quick, team: We’re seeing lots of threats to democracy nationwide, and in just a few weeks, Wisconsin will elect a new state supreme court justice. **Here are three reasons you should care:** **(1) The future of fair maps is on the line.**

Wisconsin has some of the most gerrymandered maps in the country, making it almost impossible for Democrats to win a majority in the state legislature. This election could give Wisconsin the opportunity to overturn these rigged maps and replace them with fair ones.

**(2) Reproductive freedom is on the line.**

A law pre-dating the Civil War imposed a total abortion ban in Wisconsin, and after _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, that ban was reinstated. This election could determine whether this nineteenth-century law is enforced.

**(3) The 2024 presidential election is on the line.**

In 2020, Wisconsin came closer than any other state to overturning the presidential election results in response to Donald Trump’s baseless lawsuits. Now, right-wing election deniers are spending record amounts of money to elect a judge who they believe could help invalidate the presidential election results in 2024. For these reasons, we should care about Wisconsin, but these threats to democracy are also spreading across the country. There’s a lot at stake team – so here’s one way you can help: **By donating to the NDRC!**

The NDRC is working in states like Wisconsin and across the country to elect leaders who believe in democracy, stop GOP map manipulation, protect our election infrastructure, and more. clean_body: and 1️⃣ way you can help | We’ll keep this quick, team: We’re seeing lots of threats to democracy nationwide, and in just a few weeks, Wisconsin will elect a new state supreme court justice. Here are three reasons you should care: (1) The future of fair maps is on the line. Wisconsin has some of the most gerrymandered maps in the country, making it almost impossible for Democrats to win a majority in the state legislature. This election could give Wisconsin the opportunity to overturn these rigged maps and replace them with fair ones. (2) Reproductive freedom is on the line. A law pre-dating the Civil War imposed a total abortion ban in Wisconsin, and after Roe v. Wade was overturned, that ban was reinstated. This election could determine whether this nineteenth-century law is enforced. (3) The 2024 presidential election is on the line. In 2020, Wisconsin came closer than any other state to overturning the presidential election results in response to Donald Trump’s baseless lawsuits. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

subject: Under the Dome - Your Update from the Legislature
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132940?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear Friend,

**Sometimes the most significant actions the Legislature takes are not passing laws, but choosing who is appointed to agency boards. **

The Senate Education Committee rejected Gov. Tate Reeves' appointment, Carra Powell, to the State Board of Education. Carra Powell is an advocate for school choice, has children in Mississippi public schools and would have been a phenomenal asset to the state board. We are deeply disappointed in the committee's decision to reject her appointment.

**This will be my final legislative update to all of you for the year as the 2023 Legislative Session is drawing to a close. **I've enjoyed getting to write these emails, researching various policies and hearing feedback from many of you.** **

Here is what has been going on during this last week at the Capitol!

While many appropriations bills have already been passed by lawmakers, several large-spending bills still need to be discussed. Agencies have been advocating to legislators about what funds they will need to properly operate, and the legislature has to decide what to include and not include in the state budget.

**In order to provide money for struggling rural hospitals in the state, the legislature passed[SB 2372](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=88d8716036&e=5703353baa), which establishes the "Mississippi Hospital Sustainability Grant Program." **The program will provide $103.7 million to hospitals that meet certain criteria to help prevent the closure of rural hospital systems.

After this past weekend's devastating tornadoes, disaster-relief dollars will more than likely be added to the state's budget. **Both Senate Appropriations Chairman Briggs Hopson and Gov. Tate Reeves requested that approximately $5 million be allocated to relief efforts. **

After the proposed ballot initiative measure died on the calendar last Thursday, the Senate is attempting to suspend legislative rules in order for the initiative to be brought up again.

**[SCR 572](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=7ab6828e60&e=5703353baa) would allow the legislature to revive [SCR 533](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=fa2cb097fa&e=5703353baa), the ballot initiative bill, and continue working on providing a process for direct democracy.** It passed the Senate and has been transferred to the House.

The initiative process would require signatures of 12% of Mississippians who voted in the last presidential election in order for a referendum, but this bill excludes particular topics from being placed on the ballot, such as Medicaid expansion and abortion. If the House approves the suspension of rules, lawmakers have one final chance to work on this bill before session closes.

**[HB 1310](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=08943f0437&e=5703353baa) revises provisions related to the integrity of elections.**

In an effort to clean up voter rolls, county offices will survey voters. If someone has not voted at least once during a four-year span, which will include a Presidential election, they will be placed on an inactive list and sent a letter asking if they still live at their current residence. Voters then have four years following that to respond before officially being taken off of the voter roll. Voters on the inactive list can still vote through affidavit ballots.

**The Mississippi House passed[HB 1315](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=bf6cdf6c04&e=5703353baa) on Monday, which restricts minors' access to pornographic materials.** This bill ensures that children cannot access explicit material in schools and public libraries.

Although there may only be a few more days left of the session, several controversial bills are still undetermined.

**[HB 1020](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=b915e1414d&e=5703353baa), or the "CCID bill," has been recommitted for further conference discussion, with a committee tasked with finding a compromise between the two chambers. **

The conference report of the bill gives Capitol Police jurisdiction over the entire city of Jackson. It also provides for four temporary judges, three new assistant public defenders and two assistant district attorneys, all of which would be appointed by the Attorney General. The Capitol Complex Improvement District would have its own judge, which would be appointed by the Mississippi Supreme Court Chief Justice.

The decision to fully fund the Mississippi Adequate Education Program is also still undetermined.

**While[HB 1369](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=d23100350b&e=5703353baa), a bill to increase funding for state education by $181 million, died on the calendar Monday, some officials are wanting to suspend the rules for this legislation in order to continue the discussion for education funding. **

Have a great rest of your week!
---

All the best,

Tyler B. Jones

subject: We cannot return to this
body:
The Biden administration may restart family detentions. | | | Do you remember what family detentions look like, Peter? Family detentions look like children being ripped away from their parents — causing long-lasting physical and psychological harm. They look like families separated, locked up, and forced to sleep on cold floors with no end in sight. They look like medical neglect and mistreatment at the hands of ICE and CBP officials. We rallied and advocated to put an end to these cruel, inhumane family detentions — _and we won._ **But earlier this month, it was reported that the Biden administration is considering plans to restart detentions for migrant families seeking safety and shelter.** President Biden promised to keep families together — and we at UWDA will not let his administration forget. Peter, we need your help to fight back against this misguided proposal. **Make a donation to support UWDA’s advocacy efforts as we fight to keep families together. We have a shot to win this and kick Jim Jordan to the curb for good. Together, we can vote him out of office. This is our best shot, but I need your help, friend.

body:
Peter Willis,

In 2 days, Our Revolution will reach our
first end-of-quarter deadline of 2023, and with corporate power
consolidating control over both parties, the stakes are high.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8497?t=1009&akid=4156%2E5885482%2EUEXx_2 ]Can I count on you to chip in to help close our $59,391 budget gap to
fund our critical work to take on the power of big money and restore a
democracy of the people in the United States?

As President Biden gears up for his re-election bid, we must make it clear
that to earn the trust and votes of young and progressive voters — he must
deliver for people and the planet. That means using executive action and
the bully pulpit to advance climate protections, worker rights, and more.

Instead, the President and Democratic leaders are moving in the opposite
direction - approving massive oil drilling projects in Alaska, breaking
rail strikes for paid sick leave, and siding with corporate elites
.
This doesn't just endanger our environment and economy, it directly
threatens our democracy by suppressing voter energy and giving right-wing
fascists a better chance to take back power in 2024.

That's why Our Revolution is working overtime to rally the progressive
movement to pressure the Democratic Party to pick a side and deliver now
for working people and the planet.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8497?t=1010&akid=4156%2E5885482%2EUEXx_2 ]Can I count on you to pitch in to support this important work before
our first quarterly deadline of 2023?

If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to
Our Revolution will process immediately.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8495?refcode=EM_NBI_OR_20230329_FR_EOQ_0_12MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Larry&t=1015&akid=4156%2E5885482%2EUEXx_2 ]CHIP IN $250 NOW » [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8496?refcode=EM_NBI_OR_20230329_FR_EOQ_0_12MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Larry&t=1016&akid=4156%2E5885482%2EUEXx_2 ]CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT »

Right now, President Biden and national Democratic House and Senate
majority leaders Hakeem Jeffries and Chuck Schumer ALL need to be
challenged on their commitment to real change versus slick messaging.

We can’t let Democrats reverse course on climate, sit on the sidelines
when it comes to labor, and generally start tacking to the right ahead of
the next election instead of delivering results now while they have the
power.

We have a moment right now where we must prove to the American people that
this is a party of democracy that takes action and stands in stark
contrast to an extremist Republican Party. If Democrats are going to win
in 2024,our progressive movement needs to ramp up the pressure now.

When we organize, we win.

Larry Cohen

body:
Guns are now the leading cause of death among children in the United States of America. Not car crashes. Not cancer.

Guns are now the leading cause of death among children in the United States of America. Not car crashes. Not cancer.
It’s guns.
And Republicans? Cowards.
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/1857?t=1&akid=1183%2E4767699%2EYghTZH)
Complicit.
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/1858?t=2&akid=1183%2E4767699%2EYghTZH)
The United States is the only developed country in the world where this happens. We know how to fix it.
California has some of the strongest gun laws in the country and some of the lowest per-capita firearm fatality rates.
States like Texas, for example, with weaker gun laws, have higher per-capita death rates.
It’s not hard to see, folks.
The idea that we put up with this in America is ridiculous.
Gavin

| | _**Our goal with the MassDems Wire is to give you the tools to boost Democrats and take on the GOP and their Republican allies. Use this information on social media, as the basis for a letter to the editor of your local paper, in emails to your personal network, or in conversation with your friends and neighbors.**_
---
|
---
| | Dear Peter, This Friday is Transgender Day of Visibility, a day dedicated to recognizing and uplifting transgender, nonbinary, and gender nonconforming people; while also shining a light on the discrimination they face all around the world. Let’s use this day to acknowledge their strength and joy. Unfortunately, despite progress, trans people continue to face discrimination, harassment, and barriers to opportunity around the globe — especially trans people of color. But, you can do your part in supporting trans people by taking the time to educate yourself and others on the history and policies that Democrats are developing to create real change. Here at Mass Dems, we stand with those who are a part of this community, now stand with us in support. To help, we’ve put together some celebratory events, ways to take action, and creative assets to share with your networks.
**Please forward this email to your networks and don't hesitate to reach out to me directly at brie@massdems.org about using the guidance below.**
Sincerely,

**Brie Bristol**
Digital Content Manager
Massachusetts Democratic Party
---

---

# **Ways to Take Action**
---
| |
* Post on social media by recording a short video about what Transgender Day of Visibility means to you. Post a direct-to-camera (selfie!) video on why female representation in politics matters, don’t forget to include hashtags #TDOV2023, #TransVisibility, #TransDayOfVisibility, or #TransRightsAreHumanRights.

* Use your phone to film yourself vertically from the chest up.
* Record in a well lit room or in front of a window. If possible, try to find a neutral wall or background.
* Make sure you’re in a quiet area and avoid sources of background noise like cars, parks, bodies of water, etc.
* Record less than 30 seconds. Don’t be afraid to record multiple takes to get a clean video!
* Post them on Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram, ask your friends to uplift these posts, and don’t hesitate to flag them for us by DMing @massdems.
* After you film your selfie video, use the sample posts and creative assets below to keep spreading the word about Transgender Day of Visibility online:

_Post #1_ Visibility matters. Today and every day, we stand with the transgender community and affirm their right to be seen, heard, and valued. #TransDayOfVisibility _Post #2_ On this Transgender Day of Visibility we honor and uplift the voices of transgender people who have fought and continue to fight for their rights, dignity, and freedom. _Post #3_ Transgender Day of Visibility is a day to celebrate the progress we've made in advancing transgender rights and to continue the fight for a more just and equitable world for all. Let's keep pushing forward! #TDOV2023 _Post #4_ To all the transgender individuals out there: You are valid, you are loved, and you deserve to be seen and heard. Happy Transgender Day of Visibility! _Post #5_ Visibility is important for the transgender community because it helps break down barriers and promote understanding and acceptance. Today and always, let's stand with our transgender friends and loved ones. #TransRightsAreHumanRights

It's no surprise that a majority of Kentuckians approve of the job Andy's doing as governor. Peter,

I'm proud of what my administration has accomplished in just three years. We've restored voting rights to 180,000 Kentuckians, expanded healthcare access, created tens of thousands of jobs, and achieved the lowest unemployment rate in the history of the Commonwealth.

Kentucky is on the right path, but if we're going to protect and grow our progress, we must win this race in November. It won't be easy. We won by just over**_5,000_ votes** last election, and this year is shaping up to be just as close.

The truth is, with outside money already pouring into Kentucky and 12 Republican opponents vying for their nomination, we need to ensure we're in the best position to hold off a well-funded challenger – and that starts with ending the first quarter of this election year off strong. Our very first quarterly filing deadline is around the corner and I'm hoping this team will help send a message to my opponents that Kentuckians are ready to continue moving our Commonwealth forward.

I know your rights aren't up for negotiation. That's why I took an oath to serve our nation, and my top priority is standing up to the Left's tyranny.
Our Constitutional rights have endured some of the biggest challenges in American history over these past three years. Biden has pushed vaccine mandates, tried to grow the IRS to target middle-class Americans, and wants to ensure our border stays open!
The worst part about all of this,Friend? Biden and his socialist allies are still working to strip away your rights and force their socialist agenda onto the American people!

Last night, I filed my legal response to Big Tech's attempt to throw out my RICO case against them. | | | | [](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FQ763yzqKvZ763vZjzLb5VOi0zw%2Fr7kxvWQDGLiArAsu1S8boQ/1/010001872ec8034c-b09bc3a5-ba26-4f10-b716-02073a83e751-000000/23-Yd84NTQTdgPK2cka2Fzyp8y8=315) | [](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FQ763yzqKvZ763vZjzLb5VOi0zw%2Fr7kxvWQDGLiArAsu1S8boQ/2/010001872ec8034c-b09bc3a5-ba26-4f10-b716-02073a83e751-000000/jnegfYDocOjP4GB-005mt7-8JBQ=315) Dear Friend,

Last night, my legal team and I filed our response to Big Tech's attempt to throw out my RICO lawsuit that I filed against them.

Their primary argument was _res judicata_ , which is saying that the matters I bring up in my case against them have already been adjudicated in my previous lawsuits.

But when new information comes to light, **_res judicata_ DOES NOT apply**.

And that's why **this case is still alive and I 'm still fighting to hold Big Tech accountable for suppression of speech, political censorship, fraud, and numerous violations of US election laws. [This is why I need your help more than ever before](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FQ763yzqKvZ763vZjzLb5VOi0zw%2Fr7kxvWQDGLiArAsu1S8boQ/3/010001872ec8034c-b09bc3a5-ba26-4f10-b716-02073a83e751-000000/FNWpZS50cNz_yPKUqmo_SU6r1H0=315).**

Twitter and Facebook's actions go beyond silencing me and both of my federal Congressional campaigns. They silenced MILLIONS OF AMERICANS over dissent regarding the false government and media narratives about COVID and the 2020 election.

They favored liberal politicians and suppressed, censored or silenced conservative candidates, directly interfering with our elections.

Even today, they work to minimize the school shooting in Nashville that left six dead, including three children, because the shooter was a transsexual terrorist - a group that falls within Big Tech's "protected class."

**If we don 't break the Big Tech Mafia's stranglehold on speech today, they will be controlling every aspect of our lives in the future, just like China's Social Credit System.**

[Will you accept that tyranny, or will you choose to fight with me?](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FQ763yzqKvZ763vZjzLb5VOi0zw%2Fr7kxvWQDGLiArAsu1S8boQ/4/010001872ec8034c-b09bc3a5-ba26-4f10-b716-02073a83e751-000000/LSvZiIdykKjusBhw2Ot4Fi2zOpM=315)

Since filing my RICO case against Facebook, Twitter, Mark Zuckerberg and Jack Dorsey, Big Tech's secrets have been leaking out. And now, Big Tech's dam is about to burst.

* They colluded with each other and the federal government to suppress the voices of prominent conservatives, political candidates, and elected politicians.

* Twitter was caught red-handed violating its internal policy over the Hunter Biden laptop story, and Zuckerberg even admitted he was wrong to ban any mention of the story on Facebook but was pressured by the FBI to do so.

* Facebook and Twitter were busted during a recent Congressional Oversight Hearing where it was disclosed they coordinated with DHS, and even state election officials on a private cloud server called JIRA to silence conservatives and interfere in US elections.

* Even Twitter's new owner, Elon Musk, admitted in a Tweet that he inherited a "crime scene" when he purchased the social media platform.

The Big Tech Mafia is now exposed like John Gotti's mugshot was on the front page of the _New York Times._

And just like Gotti, who was head of the Gambino Crime family, it will take RICO convictions to take the Big Tech Mafia down!

With your help, we can dismantle the criminal enterprise of Big Tech and hold them accountable . . . So please, [help me do that today by making a donation to back my RICO case](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FQ763yzqKvZ763vZjzLb5VOi0zw%2Fr7kxvWQDGLiArAsu1S8boQ/5/010001872ec8034c-b09bc3a5-ba26-4f10-b716-02073a83e751-000000/Ds7pvQ40ji_IDXk_lIujH_mpgXs=315).

Thanks again for all that you do.

Respectfully,

Laura Loomer

Dear Fellow American, "The Constitution is kind of trash." That's what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash." And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we're serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn't run from them. We should embrace them. **That 's why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, ["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7361efeb6b63406d968e1fe28395e021&_e=2d8-D0HMFBRAgnMdTbkaxpZslJiHNBrZ2NKXhpqqo1BCl2JKDO6kQ79ThQ7gggHvatgRckK1Gs0XhHkaDrBxgA-ZXokSXD6SZisznuhr_vOXAfn_t8m1t8eTngeyNXwAuP7cDAnkfPzo5XHdjScwe8OZUlQD9kl6Vl8B3T6mNMbegESBO_JajsIfpdmrZNXHNlyEt2I3xbo1H56HFnOxSccao05g4U5yP2EplQSMMEzXRxhvYDmVBXBIdmM2s4qmgdyF4GQPdNSuqalwbZmjI0pgeb4ohqjtxOivwpLKvAn5-_MfafmbEzOLI6Gb_DCQltFrO3M32IUZloYjpGLLkgVqAgkKNG_9dDKc7Zq-UduK-FWp7eZWgoCQlgL0CK7TJ85rjL4v_rNG_O5waPvwlrYrirjfjJaypl31jpnFbX0%3D)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

| | Fellow Conservative, For years and years Radical Leftists have made it their mission to turn our country on its head, and attack everything that we stand for.

Through throwing out labels like “bigot,” “deplorable” and “racist,” the Woke Mob has just about everyone in politics scared into submission, and in fear of being canceled.

[ **But I say enough is enough.**](http://links.teammorrisey.com/u/click?_t=b0356ef447a34444a1b227ba5b6fa8b2&_m=cc0ccb5bdce641abb28bc46e22a3bc7b&_e=3r4Iu7L7KaDiR9cp8XrOYBGi8ls2s9Nm9oZ46km9wryFQvO4sKcLrQtvpvKTNqpVM9YFZ-rkn9dz0yW4P4sEd1nnU644kPZBfg_KRUozvuL9RABNaQDYJbLqcUj1KwYib2Jif4mjkdDsf50-13udjD_A_40n5CdgVAhI-zej86mysItshqMRzArx_GTOG7CLrC-31aw0UkcxxClUMMyP4lzfH8lekAWqv4Zn5KDPp3wGw_0flU4lPcH1S4v3XI393z79JhjYZxSl0A47QuDmTLHCK9gzdGS5VckRCpCBH0cKO7xNx8swFKsVAvVzgg8A5g5UfoozvSCljQVsZGgUd2EcREFACGbA-fgDS_WVGAYEBzaU_sgG5UK3ejpqcsFhZUlDeg3D6wpPtBLKGzILfQ%3D%3D) Now, just days before one of Conservatives’ most important deadlines of the election cycle, the Radical Left is at it again.

Their unrelenting attacks against President Trump and America First Patriots have no end in sight. **[_And I, for one, am not just going to sit on the sidelines while liberal activists and their allies in the mainstream media wage a woke war against our great nation._](http://links.teammorrisey.com/u/click?_t=b0356ef447a34444a1b227ba5b6fa8b2&_m=cc0ccb5bdce641abb28bc46e22a3bc7b&_e=3r4Iu7L7KaDiR9cp8XrOYBGi8ls2s9Nm9oZ46km9wryFQvO4sKcLrQtvpvKTNqpVM9YFZ-rkn9dz0yW4P4sEd1nnU644kPZBfg_KRUozvuL9RABNaQDYJbLqcUj1KwYib2Jif4mjkdDsf50-13udjD_A_40n5CdgVAhI-zej86mysItshqMRzArx_GTOG7CLrC-31aw0UkcxxClUMMyP4lzfH8lekAWqv4Zn5KDPp3wGw_0flU4lPcH1S4v3XI399RTgfJ8KTj0-IQMqCW2HEvBsZivGL0PRS5F5ZepxFOGUjO5ohALOeWXVPwxfADCIcWuZ41p01ZyZ8P0_mMmsDJUV1MAXQ25FnMCzIYXGzVn3u-9W_YeYUaTFWGY9ict8HJ4zzOaCzWRCfti_B0lTNQ%3D%3D) **

As far as I am concerned, any extreme liberal nutball who loves communism so much should go and give it a try in places like China, Cuba or Venezuela. Because America is not, and WILL NOT, be a communist country.

While the woke warriors on the left spend their time peddling in some imaginative happy-go-lucky, everything-is-free eutopia, I am going to remain firmly planted in reality.

[ **And the reality we are facing right now is that if we don’t stand up and take the reins back from the Radical Left, the America we once knew is as good as gone.**](http://links.teammorrisey.com/u/click?_t=b0356ef447a34444a1b227ba5b6fa8b2&_m=cc0ccb5bdce641abb28bc46e22a3bc7b&_e=3r4Iu7L7KaDiR9cp8XrOYBGi8ls2s9Nm9oZ46km9wryFQvO4sKcLrQtvpvKTNqpVM9YFZ-rkn9dz0yW4P4sEd1nnU644kPZBfg_KRUozvuL9RABNaQDYJbLqcUj1KwYib2Jif4mjkdDsf50-13udjD_A_40n5CdgVAhI-zej86mysItshqMRzArx_GTOG7CLrC-31aw0UkcxxClUMMyP4lzfH8lekAWqv4Zn5KDPp3wGw_0flU4lPcH1S4v3XI39z8aH29E0JAj4qqaZJRhicJY6VqHGqnAsmB48uqpmy8BWcUj79QOew6NfJe40xHPfgZ--5uzb2_3xxWAeP-OQA8c5Ol7MBUAZq7Ztj_IS5r9CATqBsrUNSKaON9LQn44yAaocDQ7cCT6qp8t3_r92eQ%3D%3D)

Our fundraising goals are not arbitrary

Friends -
When it comes to ending gun violence in our communities, the fight never stops.
Every day, innocent people in our nation are victims of gun violence. Just this past week, we watched tragedy unfold in Nashville as six innocent lives were stolen due to a senseless act of violence. Countless others are victims of gun violence every single day—most of whose stories we don’t see in the headlines. We cannot rest until we see a future where we can live our lives without the risk or fear of gun violence.

That work is powered by the contributions made to Giffords PAC from supporters like you.

| | Last week marked 20 years since the United States invaded Iraq. **I was one of 23 senators who voted against the invasion** because I was never presented with compelling evidence of a clear and present threat to our national security. In fact, the night before the vote I helped make public a letter from CIA leaders that said Saddam was unlikely to attack the United States. One of my biggest regrets is that more of my colleagues didn't listen. The deeply politicized authorization for the use of military force (AUMF) passed anyway. Ever since presidents have used this open-ended authorization to carry out military actions in Iraq. Throughout that time, I worked to bring the troops home. Finally, in 2012, President Obama declared the Iraq war over, and most of our soldiers came home. **Still, 2,500 active-duty military personnel remain in Iraq today.** **This invasion must end.** It's past time to repeal this AUMF and bring ALL of our troops home. That's why today, I was proud to vote 'yes' on long-overdue legislation to repeal both the 1991 and 2002 authorizations, bringing this chapter to a close. It just passed on the Senate floor with bipartisan support. **Authorizations for the use of military force should not be indefinite. Congress, not the president, has the power to declare war.** Twenty years ago, I voted against this senseless war, and this week, I stuck by my principles and voted again to end this conflict. name: Ro Khanna
subject: The Willow Project is a step backward
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
We must take action to address climate change now.
#
Friend,
Climate scientists say we’re only 12 years away from experiencing the irreversible effects of climate change. We owe our children and future generations the hope of a livable planet. But in order to deliver, Congress needs to act soon including a moonshot investment in producing clean renewable energy.
The Administration’s approval of the Willow Project is a step backward. This project will prolong our dependence on dirty fossil fuels, slow the transition to renewables, and make it impossible to reach our goal of keeping global warming below 2 degrees Celsius.
The economic benefits from this project are short-term. A healthy planet is forever.
[**Sign if you agree: We must take action to address climate change now and reject projects that cause long-term environmental harm.**](https://act.rokhanna.com/sign/willow-project-renewable-energy-petition/?t=6&akid=2670%2E946728%2EObXCD2)
Instead of investing in more large-scale oil projects like the Willow Project, we must invest in clean energy. Not only is it good for the environment, but it also creates long-term economic growth. Green energy is creating millions of well-paying jobs throughout the country. By committing to a green energy future, we can create a stable, prosperous, and sustainable world for our children.
[**We can’t let America fall behind in the race to power the future with clean energy. Sign the petition and tell Congress to invest in renewable energy!**](https://act.rokhanna.com/sign/willow-project-renewable-energy-petition/?t=7&akid=2670%2E946728%2EObXCD2)
Onward,
Ro

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
A discussion of leadership and partisanship in today's complicated world | | |

|
---
| | | The Christie Institute for Public Policy cordially invites you to:
## An Evening with United States Senator Cory Booker
---
|
---
| Continuing The Christie Institute’s commitment to intelligent, thoughtful discussion on topics of importance to our country, I invite you to my fireside chat with U.S. Senator Cory Booker, where we will discuss leadership and bipartisanship in today’s complicated political world.

We would be grateful for your input by attending our upcoming program at Seton Hall Law School in Newark on Wednesday, April 12, at 7:00 p.m., preceded by a reception beginning at 6:00 p.m., also at the law school. We will have a substantial period for questions, answers, and audience commentary after our discussion.

Kindly register for the event at [www.christieinstitute.com.](https://christieinstitute.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c62c4d5c98958cc280ee81bb&id=e8dc360d2c&e=65ae29fa7e) Tickets for the event for all our guests are complimentary. If you have any questions, please reach out to the Institute’s Executive Director Michele Brown at [mbrown@christieinstitute.com.](mailto:mbrown@christieinstitute.com)

We hope you can join us.
---
|
---
| Governor Chris Christie

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

“Go live where you want to live, practice what you want to practice, but you're not going to fit in well [here],” McArdle said. It’s a race between two starkly different futures for Chicagoans. While Brandon’s vision includes access to affordable housing, healthcare for all, and fully-funded public schools, his opponent’s threatens budget cuts and major privatization efforts enforced by militarized police. It's not an understatement to say that these are arguably two of the most important races of 2023. And in Chicago, on that same day, WFP-endorsed mayoral candidate Brandon Johnson — a former public school teacher and union organizer — will go toe-to-toe with Paul Vallas, a Republican in disguise with a history of undermining public schools in New Orleans, Philadelphia, and Connecticut. It’s a race between two starkly different futures for Chicagoans. While Brandon’s vision includes access to affordable housing, healthcare for all, and fully-funded public schools, his opponent’s threatens budget cuts and major privatization efforts enforced by militarized police. It's not an understatement to say that these are arguably two of the most important races of 2023. But, with everything happening right now — trains derailing, banks collapsing, and compounding crises unfolding all around us — many people are unaware that these elections are even happening, or what’s at stake. It’s why we’ve been working through the month to educate voters on the stakes of these and other elections. And we can't afford to slow down at such a critical time. Seven years ago, I was appointed Secretary of the Department of Transportation and Development at a time when Louisiana faced record budget deficits and a slumping economy. We brought together local, state, and federal leaders. Democrats, Republicans, and Independents. Business owners, farmers, neighborhood associations, and everyone in between to build consensus. The successes we achieved were possible because we put political differences aside, bridged the divide, and came together to make meaningful progress. That’s the only way to move Louisiana forward. body:

| Introducing Dr. Kelli Ward as Arizona Chairwoman of Rethink! GOP
---
| Friend,
I am excited to announce that Dr. Kelli Ward, an accomplished American osteopathic physician and politician, has joined Rethink! GOP as our Chairwoman for Arizona. With Dr. Ward's leadership, we will continue to provide innovative get -out - the - vote solutions that make it easier for people to cast their ballots, and help to ensure that all votes are counted fairly.
At Rethink! GOP, we believe that maximizing voter turnout among Republican supporters is crucial to winning future elections. Our methods can help to increase voter participation, especially among groups that may have difficulty getting to the polls on Election Day. With our solutions, you can be sure that your vote will count!
Dr. Kelli Ward is no stranger to politics. She served as the chair of the Arizona Republican Party from 2019 to 2023, and prior to that, she served in the Arizona State Senate from 2013 to 2015. She won the District 5 seat in the highly contested 2012 Republican primary with 42.2% of the vote and later won the general election with 71.2% of the vote.

We want to keep the momentum going.
#
Hey — Lauren here, AOC’s Communications Director.
We've written to you about this before, but it's worth repeating. **Unlike most politicians, Alexandria doesn't do a minute of call time.**
That means Alexandria spends all her time and energy fighting for progressive legislation, organizing our communities, and standing up against powerful special interests. It also means we rely on small-dollar donations from folks like you to fund our campaign and get new voters off the sidelines.
The first Federal Election Commission fundraising deadline of the year is coming up this Friday at midnight, and we want to make sure the numbers we submit represent the strength of this people-powered movement.
[We've set a goal to bring in 5,780 contributions by our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline on March 31. Can you help us get there with a $3 donation today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230329-2.3KKhZH&refcode=em20230329-4057-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4057%2E2526796%2EbnG08P)

Friday's FEC deadline is important for us because it shows the right wing that support for Alexandria is strong, not just in NY-14 — but in your city and across the country.

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature Is Needed: Demand bold plastic solutions at the federal level
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1694977?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **Friend, from the very moment of production, plastics are harming our planet and every aspect of life on Earth:** **● FIRST →** Massive amounts of _fossil fuels_ are burned to make plastic, emitting _harmful greenhouse gases_ into the atmosphere and worsening global warming. **● MEANWHILE →** The _hazardous pollutants_ from these industrial-sized facilities are released into the air, posing _serious health risks_ for nearby residents, who are most often rural, low-wealth, and communities of color. **● THEN →** A garbage truck of plastic waste ends up in the ocean every minute, _killing over a million marine species_ like baby sea turtles that often mistake plastic debris for food, become entangled in it, or _choke to death._ **● OR →** The plastic that doesn’t end up in our waters and oceans gets dumped into landfills or burned, seeping into the soils,_contaminating our crops and air,_ building up and accumulating on Earth without decomposing. **● NOW →** Because plastic doesn’t disappear, it instead breaks down into tiny toxic microplastics that are currently _making their way into our food, water, and air._ _**● ...SOON →**_ If plastic pollution continues at this rate, plastics will _completely consume our planet,_ and the **_PLASTIC APOCALYPSE_** will threaten to destroy life on Earth as we know it. **We still have the chance to END this vicious cycle and STOP plastics from taking over the planet. But we need your help pressuring the Biden administration to take bold action immediately. [Are you still in this fight to defend the Earth against plastic pollution? Add your name now! >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1694978?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1694979?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Let’s be clear, Friend:** The federal government has __**FAILED**__ to adequately curb the **plastic crisis** \-- and it has enabled greedy fossil fuel and plastic corporations to gain control, operating at a massive scale, **_while raking in astronomical profits._**
After the shale gas boom significantly increased drilling and fracking in the U.S., the plastic industry has built a **powerful empire**. Since then, **Big Plastic and Big Oil** have yet to be held accountable by the EPA for plastic’s _devastating environmental harms to people, wildlife, and the planet._
Today, plastic consumption is up _**4 TIMES**_ what it was 30 years ago, and unless the EPA steps up right away to reign in rampant plastic pollution, our planet will soon face **_catastrophic consequences._ [This isn’t a future problem -- this is happening RIGHT NOW, Friend. The PLASTIC APOCALYPSE could occur during this lifetime if we don’t step up and demand urgent solutions. Tell the federal government to protect our planet from plastics before it’s too late! >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1694980?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1694979?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Thanks for your urgent action,
Friends of the Earth**

#
Hi Derek,
We're *sooooo* close to reaching our end-of-quarter goal of $50,000, but we're still facing a fundraising gap. Our team is powerful -- and YOU are a key part of it. That's why we're calling on this team to step up once again. 💪
**[Can you help us out by rushing a donation of $5 or anything you can afford right now? name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Dem Congresswomen need your support

body:
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?refcode=20230329_em_sjj_eoqdcccfl [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?refcode=20230329_em_sjj_eoqdcccfl]
Friends, if you know one thing about me, it might be that I’m really passionate about representation in government. To me, it’s a no-brainer: If we don’t have women in Congress (as one example), how on earth can we expect Congress to have an understanding of the challenges faced by more than half our country’s population? (Let alone find solutions to those challenges!)
So right now, with Congressional re-election campaigns back in full swing, I’m focused on my own race - but I’m also thinking about the bigger picture of what our next Congress might look like.
The way I see it, if we can harness our collective passion and power to support not just one, but lots of women running for office, we can do a lot of things at once:
*
Elect
more
Democratic
women
*
Secure
better
representation
for
the
American
people
*
And
take
back
the
House
in
2024
So here’s my pitch to you today: Make an impact on the big picture by splitting a donation between my re-election campaign and the 15 women of the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee’s Frontline. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2024frontlinejacobs?refcode=20230329_em_sjj_eoqdcccfl] These are the incumbent Democrats that our party leadership has determined MOST need your support in the upcoming elections.
When we zoom out, we can see big strides on this front. Last year, we elected one of the most diverse Congresses in history, with women making up 28% of all members. That’s a big deal.
But the truth is that, by and large, Congress remains a very male, very white, and very cisgender legislative body. Throughout our country’s history, leaders have far too often used their positions of power to represent their own interests in policymaking and governance. It’s why we’re still fighting for basic human rights for anyone who doesn’t fit that mold, and it’s why we still have so much more to do.
I’m committed to using my time in Congress to tackle critical issues like fighting climate change and securing reproductive freedoms. We can’t cede any ground in our fight for representation. That’s one reason holding the seats we already have is so critical - it’s a lot easier to keep making gains if we’re not simultaneously dealing with losses!
So let’s do this. Click here to split a donation between me and 15 of my Democratic colleagues who are running in important races in 2024. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2024frontlinejacobs?refcode=20230329_em_sjj_eoqdcccfl]
You’ll be helping the races of →
Mary Peltola (AK-AL), Yadira Caraveo (CO-08), Jahana Hayes (CT-05), Nikki Budzinski (IL-13), Sharice Davids (KS-03), Hillary Scholten (MI-03), Angie Craig (MN-02), Susie Lee (NV-03), Marcy Kaptur (OH-09), Emilia Sykes (OH-13), Andrea Salinas (OR-06), Susan Wild (PA-07), Abigail Spanberger (VA-07), Marie Gluesenkamp Perez (WA-03), and Kim Schrier (WA-08).
Representation matters. For our communities, our health care, our ability to move through the world without fear, and our right to exist as our truest selves.
Representation is critical for the future we want to create for the next generation.
With your help, we can continue to build a more inclusive, representative House and keep fighting for legislation that helps ALL people, not just some. Will you chip in to support women in Congress? Your gift will be split between my re-election campaign and 15 other Congresswomen who need your help this cycle. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2024frontlinejacobs?refcode=20230329_em_sjj_eoqdcccfl]
Thank you so much.
-Sara

62% of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck. No images? [Click here](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-e-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-e/) [](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-r/)
## **It's Wednesday. **
[](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-y/) [Schedule a CaucusRoom Live demo today!](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-j/) **Paycheck to Paycheck** [**As of February, 62% of all U.S. adults were living paycheck to paycheck, up from 60% a month earlier.**](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-t/) To make ends meet, more people have picked up a side hustle, the report also found. **Bodycam Footage Released** **[Nashville police have released bodycam video of the Covenant School shooting response,](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-i/) **during which they killed shooter Audrey Elizabeth Hale, a 28-year-old transgender former student who they say gunned down three 9-year-olds and three adults. **What a Coincidence!** While journalist Matt Taibbi was testifying before the Republican-led House committee investigating the "weaponization" of the federal government, **[an IRS agent actually showed up at Taibbi's house.](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-d/)** **Incompetent** **[The FDA admitted to having knowledge of a deadly bacteria](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-h/) **detected in a type of baby formula months before the brand was recalled. **The Right is Under Attack** A Wayne State University professor was **[suspended with pay after writing on Facebook that it is more"admirable" to kill a right-wing speaker](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-k/)** than it is to shout them down on a college campus. **Disrespectful Response** **[Biden was criticized for his response to the Nashville school shooting](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-u/) **after he joked that he only made a public appearance because he heard there would be ice cream before discussing the tragedy.

**Let****'s[ have a good laugh](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-o/)!**
* Is **[this](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-x/)** the best medicine?
* A new **[documentary](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-m/).**
* Everything is**[better now](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-c/)?**
* Who**[wore it](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qkkuhtk-trhiujldw-q/) **better**?**

body:
It’s obvious that Jim Jordan is wasting everyone’s time
| Hey, it’s Eric Swalwell. Jim Jordan wants you to believe that conservatives are _victims and are targeted unfairly by the federal government._

Cry me a river.

**That’s pretty rich coming from an insurrectionist-backer and Trump puppet like Jordan, who is hell bent on distorting the truth and facts about January 6th.**

clean_body: The Senate passed the largest climate investment in our nation’s history. We lowered prescription drug prices for millions of seniors. We took concrete action to care for our veterans. And that’s just the beginning! Now, we must keep going. | | Democrats accomplished some big things last year, Derek. I’m sure you know, but it bears repeating: The Senate passed the largest climate investment in our nation’s history. We lowered prescription drug prices for millions of seniors. We took concrete action to care for our veterans. And that’s just the beginning! Now, we must keep going. Whether it’s working to protect voting rights or to continue bringing down prices for American families, I promise to never give up on the fights that matter. We have a long road ahead of us, but I’m optimistic about what we can accomplish together. It would mean so much if you could split a $10 donation between my campaign and the DNC to support my work in the Senate and elect Democrats nationwide. The DNC has always been powered by grassroots donors giving what they can, when they can. It’s been no different for my campaign, Derek. I simply would not be in the Senate today without support from folks like you. It’s facts like these that remind me of how incredibly important it is for Democrats to hit every single one of our monthly fundraising goals -- especially this month’s goal. Friday marks the end of the first fundraising quarter of 2023, so everyone will know how much Democrats have raised. How we finish this quarter sends a strong message about the entire cycle. Thank you so much. Amy Amy Klobuchar U.S. Senator, Minnesota The DNC's Congressional Split Series helps fundraise for and raise awareness around down-ballot Democrats in some of the most important races across the country.
